stayType: Waterside pub with rooms on Irsha Street, Appledore, North Devon
accommodation: En suite king, deluxe, triple and family rooms: four above the pub and, per one listing, a further six at Sailors Rest on the quay; Sawday's lists five rooms sleeping two to four
suitableFor: Couples, groups and dog owners visiting Appledore, Northam Burrows, Westward Ho! and Saunton; walkers on the South West Coast Path
parking: No car park at the pub; West Appledore car park (EX39 1RT) is nearby
dogs: Well-behaved dogs allowed in two of the rooms and in the downstairs restaurant
beachAccess: Estuary views from the pub; Westward Ho! beach is around 1.8 miles away and Northam Burrows Country Park about half a mile. Saunton and Croyde are a short drive
confirmedFeatures: Restaurant with estuary views and terrace serving local seafood and Sunday lunch, handpumped ales, breakfast, free WiFi, on the South West Coast Path
overview: The Royal George is a reinvented old pub on Irsha Street in Appledore with floor to ceiling views over the estuary. The restaurant serves a modern British menu built around local seafood and pub classics, with a terrace and handpumped ales. Rooms are en suite and the South West Coast Path runs right past the door. Dogs are welcome in two rooms and the downstairs restaurant.
surfTripFit: A characterful estuary-side base for Westward Ho!, about 1.8 miles away, with Saunton Sands and Croyde a short drive. Appledore's pubs, shops and quay make it a good choice for a post-surf evening, and the Coast Path is on the doorstep for flat days.
gaps: Room numbers differ between listings (five at Sawday's, ten including Sailors Rest elsewhere); rates, board storage and surf group terms not confirmed.
verificationNote: Details cross-checked against public listings on 12 November 2026. Surfbooker has not stayed here; confirm facilities and policies directly when you enquire.
